complexity_ledger.narrative:
CA-05 -- the disposition requirement, at the RECONCILED epic tip e379d6b (CA-01..CA-04 all merged). Working: specs/results/scorecards/cut-the-apparatus/GOAL-consumption-obligatory/CA-05/refusal.md, .../harvest-recount.md, .../suite-CA-05.md; rule in references/consumption.md.
WHAT SHIPPED. An epic may not close while a finding it filed is undisposed: D1 a disposition that is not `open`, D2 a note on a terminal disposition, D3 a named successor on a deferral, plus a STRUCTURAL rule that refuses duplicate YAML keys before any clause runs. NOT A GATE ON ANYONE'S CODE -- it reads one file and reports on this project's own epics.
THE VERDICT AT THE RECONCILED TIP, AND IT DOES NOT PASS. `--epic cut-the-apparatus` REFUSES at 24 of 35, now on all three clauses: 16 D1 rows from CA-00, CA-01 and CA-02 that are still `open`, plus 8 CA-04 rows failing D2/D3. That is what is outstanding and those are who owe it. Ledger 245 rows = the tip's 239 plus this ticket's 6, nothing dropped or reordered.
WHAT THE REVIEW ROUNDS TOOK APART, AND IT WAS RIGHT TO. The discrimination argument this ticket first made is WITHDRAWN. subtract-to-measure was a FALSE PASS caused by seven rows of duplicate `disposition_ticket` keys that every parser silently resolved to the discarded value (CA-05-DF-06) -- CA-00-DF-04's class, shipped by an instrument in the epic that filed the class, found by a reviewer and not by me. falsifiable-instruments passes on the weakest blind spot. ports-as-adapters' 2-of-28 refusal is TWO FALSE REFUSALS, on field naming. And CA-04 added EIGHT more of the same kind. Ten false D2/D3 refusals over the record, each inspected. What survives is D1 alone: four epics filed 122 findings and routed NONE, three routed 61 cross-epic.
THE RULE IS DELIBERATELY NOT CHANGED to fix the D2/D3 false refusals. Demoting them after seeing this epic's own numbers is MF-020; CA-08 must not measure a rule that moved after seeing its data; and it would not rescue this epic, which refuses on 16 D1 rows either way. Recommended to CA-08.
THE GOOD RESULT, AND IT IS NOT MINE. CA-03 satisfied all three clauses VOLUNTARILY from the proposal alone while this PR was unmerged, and CA-03 repaired SV-04-DF-05, which carries harvest class F3 into program validation with an R1 test. Per denominator_rule: on the register repair the DENOMINATOR ROSE 38 -> 41 and the numerator held; on this one the NUMERATOR ROSE 1 -> 2 and the denominator held at 41. 2 of 41, 4.9%. Verified by hand -- the named test exists and passes, and eval_scorecard.md:769 says what RD-03-DF-08 claims.
CONSUMPTION OR ROUTING: the instrument CANNOT TELL, which is CA-05-DF-03. A person can, and did, in two commands. Any future "N consumed" from this field alone is a count of CLAIMS.
SUITE AT THE RECONCILED TIP: 8 failed / 1483 passed, EXACTLY the epic-tip baseline, item for item. The baseline moved 6 -> 8 when CA-04 merged, and CA-04 declared both new reds itself under CA-04-DF-04. CA-05 did not assume that: it checked out e379d6b in a detached worktree and ran the file, getting 2 failed / 24 passed there with this branch not involved.
MEASURED ALTERNATIVES, REJECTED. A prose-only requirement with a grep (cannot scope to an epic or check the grammar). Hiding the instrument in tests/ where the goal metric does not count it (metric-dodging). Retro-classifying `channel` on 210 older rows (would manufacture a clean history nobody measured). Building the consumption half (apparatus measuring apparatus; declared as blindness instead). Adding a `gate-refused` channel token mid-epic after seeing which rows need it.
THE HONEST ALTERNATIVE, RE-ARGUED. The retirement is QUALIFIED, not defended. Nothing has been consumed BECAUSE of the requirement -- it has been complied with, never yet binding. The description the evidence supports is "a measurement programme with a newly installed close-out requirement that three tickets have voluntarily honoured". CA-08 is the test.
PRICE, per surface, worse than first reported. scripts/ +213 (disposition.py; 80 of those added by review -- the duplicate-key guard and the channel advisory). examples/validation/ Python +0. tests/ +213. instruments.toml +75. Card UNCHANGED at 6,281 bytes / sha256:2d7d4a0506d9b259. Clause (a) of GOAL-apparatus-cut MOVED THE WRONG WAY and this ledger says so.

ticket.objective: GOAL 02, IN THE OWNER'S WORDS: 'Detection, filing, scoring and re-scoring all work. Consumption is 1 of 38 because nothing requires it. Either a filed finding must receive a disposition before an epic can close, or the honest description is a measurement programme rather than a self-improvement loop. Both are respectable; the current state is neither.' THE OWNER CHOSE THE FIRST, WITH THE REGISTER REPAIRED. FOUR PARTS. (1) A DISPOSITION REQUIREMENT: every filed finding gets an explicit disposition -- consumed, deferred with a named successor, or wontfix with a reason -- before an epic can close. THIS IS A CLOSE-OUT REQUIREMENT ON THIS PROJECT'S OWN EPICS AND NOT A GATE ON ANYONE'S CODE; seven epics of static checking caught zero bugs and this epic adds no gate. (2) R1 APPLIED TO IT: ship it with a DEMONSTRATED REFUSAL on a real input -- run it against THIS epic's own filed findings and show it refusing a real close-out, not a fixture. This project has shipped three instruments later found blind. (3) REPAIR THE REGISTER: HARVEST-CL-03.md carries 38 classes and was untouched last epic, and SV-01-DF-05 filed three new classes into the ledger and not into the harvest, SO 38 STOPPED GROWING ON 2026-08-11 AND UNDERSTATES THE BACKLOG. State the TRUE denominator and, per denominator_rule, SAY WHETHER THE NUMERATOR ROSE OR THE DENOMINATOR FELL. Read the 1-of-38 honestly: THREE OF THE FOUR NEWLY-NAMED CLASSES ARE THIS PROJECT CATCHING ITSELF COMMITTING THE CLASS, not consuming it. (4) THE TWO MISSING FIELDS: a channel field on the ledger, asked for six epics ago and still hand-classified from free text every single time; and CL-04's cost block with basis and value at ticket close-out, proposed three epics ago and never built -- SV-05 measured 353,816 tokens at 0.57 findings per 100k, comparable to SV-01's 0.98 on the same basis, AND THAT IS THE FIRST TIME TWO ROUNDS IN THIS PROGRAMME WERE COMPARABLE AT ALL. Populate both from this epic's own tickets. RUN YOUR OWN RULE AGAINST THE SEALED RECORD BEFORE SHIPPING IT, per the charter -- SV-07 refuted its predecessor's recommendation in one command by trying to ship it. AND KEEP THE HONEST ALTERNATIVE ON THE TABLE: if the requirement cannot be made to work, saying 'this is a measurement programme, not a self-improvement loop' IS AN ACCEPTABLE AND VALUABLE OUTCOME.
